faqs.a:
There is hereby imposed a tax on all sales of commodities and services specified in
section 98-66
, and not otherwise exempt in
section 98-70
, in the amount of 3.46 percent of the purchase price. In order to avoid fractions
               of pennies, the following brackets shall be applicable to all taxable transactions:
(1)
On sales amounting to $0.18 to and including $0.31, a tax of $0.01;
(2)
On sales amounting to $0.32 to and including $0.62, a tax of $0.02;
(3)
On sales amounting to $0.63 to and including $0.93, tax of $0.03;
(4)
On sales in excess of $1.00, the tax shall be 3.46 percent on each full dollar of
                  the sales price, plus the tax shown on the above schedule for the applicable fractional
                  part of a dollar of the sale price.
(Code 1981, § 31-50; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002; Ord. No. 3980, § 2, 12-12-2005)
